Container.Name: mediatryk
Container.Overview: Media server API: browses a source library of MKVs, encodes them to H.265 MP4 with HandBrake (Intel QSV when the GPU is passed in, software x265 otherwise) and streams the encoded files. API only; a separate client provides the UI.

Config.Name: API
Config.Description: HTTP port of the API and WebSocket (UAM may remap it)

Config.Name: Media library
Config.Description: Where encoded MP4s are written and streamed from. Also holds the encode queue state in .mediatryk/queue.json

Config.Name: Source library
Config.Description: Original MKVs to browse and encode (read-only)

Config.Name: Intel GPU
Config.Description: Passes the Intel GPU in for QSV hardware encoding. Clear it on a host without /dev/dri; encoding then uses software x265

Config.Name: Hardware encoding
Config.Description: Set to false to force software x265 even when QSV is available
